AI News Aggregator v1.0.0

- Initial release of a high-performance AI/tech news engine.
- Concurrently fetches 100+ RSS sources in 12 seconds with ETag/Last-Modified caching and date filtering.
- Includes technical evaluations for 2026: LangGraph v1.0, CrewAI v1.10, SDK comparisons, MCP protocol, and LLM long-context battle.
- Supports multi-category aggregation: companies, papers, media, newsletters, communities, Chinese sources, AI agents, and social feeds.
- Provides core CLI commands for news, papers, and GitHub trending aggregation.
- Fully standard-library based; no extra dependencies required.
